## 1. Prediction market

**The gap narrows for the third day.** In the confirmed reading of October 15 at 17:37 BRT, the [winner contract](https://polymarket.com/event/brazil-presidential-election) pays 77.25% for Flávio Bolsonaro (USD 20.75M) and 22.50% for Lula (USD 24.63M). Against the confirmed reading of October 14 at 18:12 BRT, Flávio Bolsonaro falls 7.75pp and Lula rises 8.00pp; since the sum of the pair went from 99.50 to 99.75, the normalized movement is 7.98pp to each side. The gap goes from 70.50pp to 54.75pp, after going from 74.55pp to 72.95pp on October 13 and from 72.95pp to 70.50pp on October 14. In the 19:31 BRT re-reading, Flávio Bolsonaro was at 77.70% and Lula at 22.50%, and the total accumulated volume in the presidential book added up to USD 183.97M. The largest volume in the book is still Lula's.

**Supreme Court and inflation.** The contract on the [impeachment of an STF justice before 2027](https://polymarket.com/event/any-brazil-stf-justice-removed-by-impeachment-before-2027) stands at 2.70% (USD 0.10M), the same as the October 14 reading. In the [2026 inflation](https://polymarket.com/event/brazil-annual-inflation-2026) one, in the 19:31 BRT reading against the October 14 one at 18:33 BRT, the 5.00% to 5.49% range goes from 50.20% to 51.10% (USD 25 thousand), the 5.50% to 5.99% range from 21.05% to 20.40% (USD 21 thousand) and the 4.50% to 4.99% range from 18.70% to 17.40% (USD 32 thousand).

## 2. What the polling firms registered

**Datafolha.** [Datafolha](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiyAFBVV95cUxNZWozaURJallmakJxMFRyNzdqcVVWN3VpXzZFcHJrZEY3VU1lcG50VGJOaUpmQWF2d2UxZDYyN0RscFJ2WXVxb2V3dkdMTGthNVZFRlRZMEZ6UzlqcndHSjNVVkNqcTU5NGRjTzdTel9lYThabk1LdEtEa1JWYXpyUEJtaEIzekJPcEhwdVRKbXhMNXhiSUhPUXYzcVBoTnFWbUFzLXdlcWpaNHZMeGpqSGx3Yzg3MHN5VXUxcFUzLVhJZTZCN0llbQ?oc=5), with 2,520 face-to-face interviews from October 13 to 15, commissioned by Folha de S.Paulo, gives [Flávio Bolsonaro 47% and Lula 45%](https://news.google.?oc=5), with 6% blank and spoiled ballots and 2% undecided; in valid votes, 51% to 49%. In the October 8 wave it was 49% to 45%, and 52% to 48% in valid votes. Lula is [rejected by 46% and Flávio Bolsonaro by 44%](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirgFBVV95cUxOWXZjQjZXMENFLW9PVWJTTWtLSjlyRTU1SGktQWl0S1BoVUZuSlJ3bVhUdXI5Y0NHX293bVB3YVVDME5Fc1JZTDlqZ01HcFYyUHpHVHVrd2NLS0s1bEM1bUFCX1BVSkwtLVJqWU9sSUtiNHQ1RUtKU0NXdGtiMzJJYW01c2FPb0hiVHM0RUxHMnpKdWdRWWhXblNGU0RmMHpEYm9wcWJBaW4tQUtZMGc?oc=5), and the Lula government has [a negative rating of 41% and a positive rating of 35%](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiugFBVV95cUxORVB5eEtOcVJ0T2xJS0x2dFRHYjFmcEhKLVZieXVqWDdBakxGWjQtTVZORWxCQ3RITzRBbzFpZU01VnZsX3VBV3VxUGN1eE1kRzYwV25NVEthTEFXSFVxWndqdENSZ3dEcVYzUW9XWVNpcV9ad3RjWlVwNjlwY2VkQnp1OHphX0dWcmZ6UmZTVUFhNUxTcXEydUZrWlF1M0k1WGNPMFQzcWRxYk90X2V6VFhiQmRzLXR4VHc?oc=5).

**Palver and Indexa.** [Palver](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirgFBVV95cUxNakJMV0FyNVlZOGlyOFFOS3dEUnZyMGRjbk4tWkM4N0UtOWp2dEwySWhDSVN0a1YxNlVLNl9DRXdlNDlLS0d3cFNrR1h6enhsWUI5OE5XNmtjVXFpc09hVmx1VTNZQlU0TmREOG9wOWlRdDBlMGpIVE5FQjcwQ1pPWWg4OW9DMzRFQkJGR3dJOWtyaER4cFg5azc1Q19qby1fMU5xTm55azdpbkdBclE?oc=5), with 5,000 online interviews from October 10 to 13, gives Flávio Bolsonaro 50% and Lula 49%, with no undecided; on October 3, the eve of the first round, it was 49% and 44%. [Indexa](https://news.google.?oc=5), commissioned by Estadão/Broadcast, with 2,000 telephone interviews on October 13 and 14, gives 44% to 42% to Flávio Bolsonaro in total votes and 51% to 49% in valid votes, and measures the Lula government as [disapproved of by 50%](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMioAFBVV95cUxOSHlkdnk2R1M4d3B5MmxWLWs3T1BjbU80bUlpam5VeWlCNWUwUE5DS3NySXhPTzRFd0hkMlJaUVplcV9jZC1ELWhHZXcyYVFDak1haEgxUTdQTHpBcVl2N1d5WjRaUUlIWDNKdDRHczBCU1pqWEw5SXBwdXhYRXpkVVVXMmw0VTNyeW51ak00TlpOd2dTeGNmRW4xSjFGSGVG?oc=5).

**The post-vote map.** Of the fourteen national polls conducted after the first round, thirteen put Flávio Bolsonaro ahead, by 1 to 9 points in total votes, and Vox Brasil of October 9 puts Lula ahead by 1.5 points. The poll side of the panel's graph is now Palver, the one with the largest sample among the day's three national polls.

## 3. What the press covered

**The 6x1 schedule.** The Senate [approved on the night of October 14 the PEC to end the 6x1 work schedule (six days on, one off)](https://news.google.?oc=5), which reduces the maximum workweek from 44 to 40 hours, by 75 votes to 1 in both rounds of voting; the [only vote against was Hamilton Mourão's](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE55TWJOWGhSX3NESlFHallqdk1zY0tHR01laGJoaXZPRnoza2hzSnJzWFZWNVRmc01RaTRZUDdyQWZ4OUdkWENkNHUzdXNVSXVrNXZWZzg0YW1CS1d3SnR3T0x3ONIBaEFVX3lxTE5aRWthMXgxQjZKYlMyQ2dOQmtUaVBkMXJCUWJ2OUlubEVRcUVFNExUWWJYUW5uZ0w5Vi15VDRaZklsQ1NNcUY1LVZueHJWN3hMSEVraExhc051ZW9aTXRPdE16Wnd6ZTls?oc=5), and the promulgation is expected for the following week. Flávio Bolsonaro [voted in favor, remotely](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimwFBVV95cUxPT1lkNkRmVDltRkxrVl9ZMGZIWlFMOV8xbnFGZHlrR1ROeDdkZ1EyOFoweHNCaFlORUpfamx2TGFwaWdEMWxxM1VxUDAySlprZVZaeklfRDkxRVlCSUV4Q2F2bkI1cU43MUxsdjhwY2dPekJNWDR3cjBvaHRqWmd5RC0xQ1RKcEY1RDUycng3OFIwaUR5Wk4wZlZxOA?oc=5). Lula [promised to send a PEC for free public transport on weekends](https://news.google.?oc=5).

**The TSE.** The TSE plenary, unanimously, [struck down on October 15 the 48-hour wait](https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/poder/2026/10/tse-derruba-regra-que-exigia-espera-de-48-horas-para-reativar-canais-de-whatsapp-como-o-exercito-do-lula.shtml) to reactivate WhatsApp channels registered after the deadline, after Kassio Nunes Marques had cleared the Exército do Lula (Lula's Army) channel on the night of October 14. The court also [overturned a decision by André Mendonça](https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/blogs/brasilia-hoje/2026/10/tse-derruba-decisao-de-mendonca-e-barra-posts-em-que-flavio-acusa-lula-de-menosprezar-garis.shtml) and ordered the removal of videos that link Lula to the alleged fraud at the INSS, according to Folha de S.Paulo and [Estadão](https://www.estadao.com.br/politica/eleicoes/tse-decide-pela-remocao-de-videos-que-associam-lula-a-supostas-fraudes-no-inss-nprp/). Flávio Bolsonaro [asked the TSE to revoke the registration of Lula's ticket](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivAFBVV95cUxPY1gxbmFUOFZSRDU4MzE3dG5HcFpDRW5mWTFOejZMaFJpYUtpZFVUQS1FQkcxbk1wb1locHR5cjNmTmptbUpkVWJXeTlNQURWRmROcE1ZSWtEZmE4dURSaUQyNkNUaHZrNkZHT0g4cW8wWU93NjhXRExPU3BMNnlKM1pxcU1wdXNfU2IyZkNndlE3TmM3cDA4cXFlU1FGSlVnTG05ajlXRjUwVE9YcnVnNTRpdlF1V1dVeTI5Xw?oc=5) over funding from unions. Kassio Nunes Marques and Mendonça [met with Meta](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipwFBVV95cUxNNDFyc2xJdXJLdFhtLTFhejZGd19qZzdBTXQ0RFl2Z3lheExjRFFtMkFNRmlxVTVGMTRNdnFZaHp5OTBuLTducXhIczVQV0MwR0NYN2NvRnFCM2hvSzRrRjhoZkVIQTl3QkNtbE5MNmI0cTV2aVJDY2c5MHF6QWZaLVB0WWxSa1RvQjFHb25jSDRXOGtWanQ3QTlJWk5JcnNNSGV5MUFYUQ?oc=5).

**The debates.** The debate of the broadcaster pool of SBT, RedeTV!, CNN Brasil and other outlets, scheduled for October 15, [was called off](https://dcmais.com.br/eleicoes-2026/emissoras-de-tv-cancelam-debates-para-o-segundo-turno-confira-a-nova-programacao/), as was the Record one of October 11. What remains is the Band one, on October 18, [the first between the two](https://news.google.?oc=5), and the Globo one, on October 23. Lula's interview on Jornal Nacional [is scheduled for the night of October 15](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwwFBVV95cUxOWURTUnRDbV93YzBUSk9peWtkZUxUWFA0dXlfRWtaQVo2c2dYYTk5MEtfN0dDbExfM3IzYmlkbVluNy1UWWlobWk2QktJMFk3bWNWN3lnb0locnJMOVY5em5PSDVyTmszelVjODBPVHhhUE5TRXI1SDRGT0ZvX1hSczM4Nkh6b2doRC1xNmJBTkVaUDdBcElTbHJFWk9WdHVic0hEcDhIbk1TMXQwdVNnRjBiS2NoemJZMU5EWEtTU1dzSzQ?oc=5), and Flávio Bolsonaro's for October 16. Renan Santos said he [does not support Lula and will not vote](https://news.google.?oc=5).

## 4. Divergences of the day

> **Market × poll:** the [winner contract](https://polymarket.com/event/brazil-presidential-election) narrowed the gap by 15.75pp between October 14 and 15, and the day's three national polls measured Flávio Bolsonaro ahead by 1 or 2 points, within the margins. Price measures the probability of winning on October 25, and the poll measures the week's voting intention.

> **Poll × poll:** [Datafolha](https://news.google.?oc=5), face-to-face, and [Indexa](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMioAFBVV95cUxOSHlkdnk2R1M4d3B5MmxWLWs3T1BjbU80bUlpam5VeWlCNWUwUE5DS3NySXhPTzRFd0hkMlJaUVplcV9jZC1ELWhHZXcyYVFDak1haEgxUTdQTHpBcVl2N1d5WjRaUUlIWDNKdDRHczBCU1pqWEw5SXBwdXhYRXpkVVVXMmw0VTNyeW51ak00TlpOd2dTeGNmRW4xSjFGSGVG?oc=5), by telephone, reach the same 51% to 49% in valid votes with different methods. The margin among the fourteen post-vote national polls ranges from 1.5 points for Lula to 9 for Flávio Bolsonaro.

> **Wave × wave:** in [Datafolha](https://news.google.?oc=5), Flávio Bolsonaro goes from 49% to 47% between October 8 and 15 and Lula stays at 45%; in [Palver](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirgFBVV95cUxNakJMV0FyNVlZOGlyOFFOS3dEUnZyMGRjbk4tWkM4N0UtOWp2dEwySWhDSVN0a1YxNlVLNl9DRXdlNDlLS0d3cFNrR1h6enhsWUI5OE5XNmtjVXFpc09hVmx1VTNZQlU0TmREOG9wOWlRdDBlMGpIVE5FQjcwQ1pPWWg4OW9DMzRFQkJGR3dJOWtyaER4cFg5azc1Q19qby1fMU5xTm55azdpbkdBclE?oc=5), the margin falls from 5 points to 1 between October 3 and 13.

## In summary

1. **Datafolha measures 47% to 45% for Flávio Bolsonaro**, and thirteen of the fourteen post-vote national polls put him ahead.
2. **The gap in the winner contract narrows for the third day**, to 54.75pp, with Lula at 22.50% and Flávio Bolsonaro at 77.25%.
3. **The Senate approved the end of the 6x1 schedule and the October 15 debate was called off**; the first is the Band one, on October 18.
